Aggregate per-cell CP10K counts of S and G1 cells over several samples

Source: R/pseudobulk.R
aggregate_pseudobulk_s_g1_counts.Rd

Reads one raw genome-bin count matrix per sample, normalises every selected cell to counts per 10,000 (the denominator is the cell's total over all raw bins, before any mappability filter) and sums the normalised counts per bin over the QC-passed S cells (is_G1 is FALSE and pass_qc is TRUE) and over the G1 cells (is_G1 is TRUE). The matrices are read one at a time.

Usage

aggregate_pseudobulk_s_g1_counts(
  genobins_files,
  meta_data,
  bin_ids,
  cache_file = NULL,
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

genobins_files

Named character vector of RDS files, one sparse bins x cells count matrix per sample; the names are the sample ids.

meta_data

A data.frame with cell ids as row names and logical columns is_G1 and pass_qc.

bin_ids

Character vector of bin ids. Each matrix must have exactly these row names (rows are reordered if needed).

cache_file

NULL or the path of an RDS cache. The cache is reused only when the files (path, size, modification time), the selected cells and bin_ids are unchanged; otherwise it is overwritten.

verbose

Print one message per sample. Default FALSE.

Value

A data.frame with columns bin_id, s_counts and g1_counts (summed CP10K, not raw reads), and attributes normalization ("cp10k_per_cell_v1") and selected_cells (cells used per sample).

Details

Cell names of a matrix that do not start with "<sample>-" get that prefix before they are matched to rownames(meta_data); every cell of every matrix must be present in meta_data. Each sample must contribute at least one S cell and one G1 cell.

See also

calculate_pseudobulk_rt_g1_ratio(), export_pseudobulk_g1_ratio()
